item.title: Morocco dominates Spain’s cucumber imports as volumes triple over a decade
item.description: Morocco accounted for nearly three‑quarters of Spain’s cucumber imports in 2025, as the country sharply increased purchases of the vegetable, according to data published by agricultural market specialist Hortoinfo.
